fields.name: listing_key
fields.description: Exchange-qualified identifier, e.g. NASDAQ:AAPL, NSE:RELIANCE, CRYPTO:BTC

fields.name: asset_class
fields.description: equity, crypto, index, commodity or fx

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO country code (GL for global crypto)

fields.name: profile_state
fields.description: observed = a verified, identity-bound profile text exists; insufficient_evidence otherwise (checked today)

fields.name: profile_as_of
fields.description: Capture date of that profile source

fields.name: research_state
fields.description: observed / insufficient_evidence / blocked research report state (checked today)

fields.name: quote_state
fields.description: live = verified price that is current for its exchange session; held_calendar_unknown = valid receipt but venue calendar not yet defined; receipt_present_unverified = stored price not in an accepted daily-source format; stale_receipt; unmeasured_no_receipt; source_failure

fields.name: quote_observed_at
fields.description: When that price was observed at source

fields.name: chart_bars
fields.description: Daily chart bars available (2+ = chart renderable)

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: When the quote/chart checks were run for this release

fields.name: record_exists
fields.description: CARRIED FROM v3: stored research source record exists

fields.name: record_checked_at
fields.description: CARRIED FROM v3, original date (2026-10-23..25), not re-dated
